grammar: n. 脾气。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: lose one's temper; have a short temper
commonMistake: 常用 lose one's temper 表示“发脾气”；temper 本身不是形容词。

example.english: He lost his temper when the storm broke his window.
example.chinese: 暴风雨打破窗户时，他发了脾气。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: He lost his temper when the storm broke his window. In this sentence, what does “temper” mean? A. 脾气  B. 野火
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “temper” 表示“脾气”，符合语境；另一项“野火”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 地震。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a strong earthquake; earthquake damage
commonMistake: earthquake 是合成词，一个词写完；可说 a strong earthquake 或 earthquake damage。

example.english: The earthquake shook buildings across the city.
example.chinese: 地震使整座城市的建筑都摇晃起来。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The earthquake shook buildings across the city. In this sentence, what does “earthquake” mean? A. 海啸  B. 地震
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “earthquake” 表示“地震”，符合语境；另一项“海啸”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 台风。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a typhoon warning; a powerful typhoon
commonMistake: typhoon 是热带风暴的一种名称；可数，复数 typhoons。

example.english: Schools closed before the typhoon reached the coast.
example.chinese: 台风到达海岸前，学校就停课了。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Schools closed before the typhoon reached the coast. In this sentence, what does “typhoon” mean? A. 台风  B. 亲戚
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “typhoon” 表示“台风”，符合语境；另一项“亲戚”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 野火。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: wildfire spread; fight a wildfire
commonMistake: wildfire 表示野火，通常合写；不要误拆成 wild fire。

example.english: Firefighters worked through the night to stop the wildfire.
example.chinese: 消防员彻夜工作以控制野火。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Firefighters worked through the night to stop the wildfire. In this sentence, what does “wildfire” mean? A. 电力供应  B. 野火
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “wildfire” 表示“野火”，符合语境；另一项“电力供应”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 雪暴。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a heavy snowstorm; during a snowstorm
commonMistake: snowstorm 是合成词；暴风雪期间可说 during a snowstorm。

example.english: The snowstorm covered the roads and delayed the buses.
example.chinese: 暴风雪覆盖了道路，公交车因此晚点。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The snowstorm covered the roads and delayed the buses. In this sentence, what does “snowstorm” mean? A. 雪暴  B. 泡
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “snowstorm” 表示“雪暴”，符合语境；另一项“泡”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 水灾；可依句法作名词或动词，动词形式随主语与时态变化。
collocations: a serious flood; flood the streets
commonMistake: flood 可作名词或动词；表示“淹没某地”时 flood 后直接接地点。

example.english: Heavy rain may flood the fields near the river.
example.chinese: 大雨可能会淹没河边的田地。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Heavy rain may flood the fields near the river. In this sentence, what does “flood” mean? A. 卫兵  B. 淹没
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “flood” 表示“淹没”，符合语境；另一项“卫兵”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 旱灾。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a long drought; severe drought
commonMistake: drought 是名词，意为长期干旱；形容词 dry 不能直接替代该名词。

example.english: The long drought left the farms without enough water.
example.chinese: 长期干旱使农场缺水。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The long drought left the farms without enough water. In this sentence, what does “drought” mean? A. 旱灾  B. 洪水
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “drought” 表示“旱灾”，符合语境；另一项“洪水”与句意不符。

grammar: v. 警告。作谓语时注意主谓一致和时态；warn–warned–warned
collocations: warn someone of danger; warn someone not to do something
commonMistake: warn sb to do / warn sb not to do；也可用 warn sb about/of sth。

example.english: Officials warned residents to leave the area.
example.chinese: 官员警告居民离开该地区。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Officials warned residents to leave the area. In this sentence, what does “warn” mean? A. 尖叫  B. 警告
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “warn” 表示“警告”，符合语境；另一项“尖叫”与句意不符。

grammar: phr. 做家务。整体记忆为固定表达；句中动词按主语和时态变化。
collocations: do household chores; do chores around the house
commonMistake: do chores 中 chores 通常用复数；不说 do a chore 表示日常家务总称。

example.english: I do chores every Saturday before I meet my friends.
example.chinese: 我每周六都会先做家务，然后再去见朋友。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: I do chores every Saturday before I meet my friends. In this sentence, what does “do chores” mean? A. 做家务  B. 一……就……
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “do chores” 表示“做家务”，符合语境；另一项“一……就……”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 波浪；可依句法作名词或动词，动词形式随主语与时态变化。
collocations: a huge wave; wave to someone
commonMistake: wave 作名词是“波浪”，作动词可表示“挥手”；注意按句法判断。

example.english: A huge wave crashed against the harbour wall.
example.chinese: 一个巨浪拍打着港口的堤墙。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: A huge wave crashed against the harbour wall. In this sentence, what does “wave” mean? A. 救援  B. 波浪
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “wave” 表示“波浪”，符合语境；另一项“救援”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 海啸。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a tsunami warning; a tsunami reaches the coast
commonMistake: tsunami 指海啸；复数常写 tsunamis，描述预警可用 tsunami warning。

example.english: The warning gave people time to move away from the coast before the tsunami arrived.
example.chinese: 海啸到来前，警报给了人们时间撤离海岸。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The warning gave people time to move away from the coast before the tsunami arrived. In this sentence, what does “tsunami” mean? A. 海啸  B. 旱灾
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “tsunami” 表示“海啸”，符合语境；另一项“旱灾”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 采访；可依句法作名词或动词，动词形式随主语与时态变化。
collocations: a job interview; interview someone
commonMistake: interview 可作名词或动词；“采访某人”直接说 interview sb，不加 about。

example.english: The reporter will interview the firefighter this afternoon.
example.chinese: 记者今天下午将采访这名消防员。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The reporter will interview the firefighter this afternoon. In this sentence, what does “interview” mean? A. 报道  B. 采访
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “interview” 表示“采访”，符合语境；另一项“报道”与句意不符。

grammar: phr. （使）慢下来。整体记忆为固定表达；句中动词按主语和时态变化。
collocations: slow down a car; slow down when driving
commonMistake: slow down 可不带宾语，也可说 slow a car down；宾语是代词时放在 slow 和 down 之间。

example.english: Drivers should slow down when the road is wet.
example.chinese: 路面湿滑时，司机应该减速。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Drivers should slow down when the road is wet. In this sentence, what does “slow down” mean? A. （使）慢下来  B. 闹钟
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “slow down” 表示“（使）慢下来”，符合语境；另一项“闹钟”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 街区。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: in the neighbourhood; a neighbourhood school
commonMistake: neighbourhood 是英式拼法，美式常写 neighborhood；按本词表记 neighbourhood。

example.english: Everyone in our neighbourhood helped after the storm.
example.chinese: 暴风雨过后，我们街区的每个人都伸出了援手。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Everyone in our neighbourhood helped after the storm. In this sentence, what does “neighbourhood” mean? A. 泡  B. 街区
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “neighbourhood” 表示“街区”，符合语境；另一项“泡”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 屋顶。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: on the roof; the roof of a house
commonMistake: roof 的常见复数是 roofs；不要按 leaf 的变化误写成 rooves。

example.english: Strong winds blew several tiles off the roof.
example.chinese: 强风把屋顶上的几块瓦吹了下来。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Strong winds blew several tiles off the roof. In this sentence, what does “roof” mean? A. 屋顶  B. 思考
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “roof” 表示“屋顶”，符合语境；另一项“思考”与句意不符。

grammar: v. 几乎。作谓语时注意主谓一致和时态；可按规则变化，遇到不规则形式以词典为准。
collocations: nearly finished; nearly reached the top
commonMistake: nearly 表示“几乎、差不多”，不等于 not nearly（远非）。

example.english: The river nearly reached the top of the flood wall.
example.chinese: 河水差点涨到防洪墙顶部。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The river nearly reached the top of the flood wall. In this sentence, what does “nearly” mean? A. 躲藏  B. 几乎
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “nearly” 表示“几乎”，符合语境；另一项“躲藏”与句意不符。

grammar: phr. 从（某物上）脱落。整体记忆为固定表达；句中动词按主语和时态变化。
collocations: come off the wall; a button comes off
commonMistake: come off 表示“脱落”时是不及物短语动词，主语是脱落的物品。

example.english: The sign may come off the wall in strong wind.
example.chinese: 大风可能会把牌子从墙上吹下来。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The sign may come off the wall in strong wind. In this sentence, what does “come off” mean? A. 从（某物上）脱落  B. （警报器等）发出响声
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “come off” 表示“从（某物上）脱落”，符合语境；另一项“（警报器等）发出响声”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 报道；可依句法作名词或动词，动词形式随主语与时态变化。
collocations: a weather report; report an accident
commonMistake: report 可作名词或动词；“报道某事”可说 report on sth，“向某人报告”可说 report sth to sb。

example.english: The newspaper published a report about the storm.
example.chinese: 报纸刊登了一篇关于这场风暴的报道。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The newspaper published a report about the storm. In this sentence, what does “report” mean? A. 复习  B. 报道
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “report” 表示“报道”，符合语境；另一项“复习”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 苦恼；可依句法作名词或动词，动词形式随主语与时态变化。
collocations: get into trouble; have trouble doing something
commonMistake: have trouble doing sth 中 doing 用动名词，不用 to do。

example.english: The fallen tree caused trouble for the morning traffic.
example.chinese: 倒下的树给早间交通带来了麻烦。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The fallen tree caused trouble for the morning traffic. In this sentence, what does “trouble” mean? A. 苦恼  B. 波浪
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “trouble” 表示“苦恼”，符合语境；另一项“波浪”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 亲戚。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a close relative; visit relatives
commonMistake: relative 指亲戚；relation 也可表示亲属关系，别把 relative 与 relatively（相对地）混淆。

example.english: My relatives came to stay with us during the flood.
example.chinese: 洪水期间，我的亲戚来和我们住在一起。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: My relatives came to stay with us during the flood. In this sentence, what does “relative” mean? A. 旱灾  B. 亲戚
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “relative” 表示“亲戚”，符合语境；另一项“旱灾”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 卡车。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a delivery truck; truck driver
commonMistake: truck 是美式英语常用词，英式英语常说 lorry；按题目语境辨认同义词。

example.english: A truck delivered drinking water to the village.
example.chinese: 一辆卡车把饮用水送到了村里。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: A truck delivered drinking water to the village. In this sentence, what does “truck” mean? A. 卡车  B. 屋顶
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “truck” 表示“卡车”，符合语境；另一项“屋顶”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 供应（量）；可依句法作名词或动词，动词形式随主语与时态变化。
collocations: supply someone with something; supply something to someone
commonMistake: 常用 supply sb with sth 或 supply sth to sb；不要把两个结构混搭。

example.english: Volunteers supplied the shelter with blankets.
example.chinese: 志愿者为避难所提供了毯子。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Volunteers supplied the shelter with blankets. In this sentence, what does “supply” mean? A. 雷  B. 供应（量）
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “supply” 表示“供应（量）”，符合语境；另一项“雷”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 准备（工作）。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: in preparation for; careful preparation
commonMistake: preparation 作准备时常用不可数；具体准备事项可用 preparations。

example.english: Good preparation can help families stay safe.
example.chinese: 充分准备能帮助家庭保障安全。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Good preparation can help families stay safe. In this sentence, what does “preparation” mean? A. 准备（工作）  B. 泡
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “preparation” 表示“准备（工作）”，符合语境；另一项“泡”与句意不符。

grammar: phr. 作准备。整体记忆为固定表达；句中动词按主语和时态变化。
collocations: make preparations for a trip; make preparations in advance
commonMistake: 固定说 make preparations for sth；prepare 是动词，preparations 是名词复数。

example.english: We must make preparations for the coming storm.
example.chinese: 我们必须为即将到来的风暴做好准备。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: We must make preparations for the coming storm. In this sentence, what does “make preparations” mean? A. 闹钟  B. 作准备
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “make preparations” 表示“作准备”，符合语境；另一项“闹钟”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 电力供应。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: power supply; lose power
commonMistake: power 可指电力或力量；断电常说 the power goes out / is cut off。

example.english: The storm cut off the power for several hours.
example.chinese: 风暴造成停电，持续了好几个小时。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The storm cut off the power for several hours. In this sentence, what does “power” mean? A. 电力供应  B. 洪水
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “power” 表示“电力供应”，符合语境；另一项“洪水”与句意不符。

grammar: v. （睡觉）酣畅地。作谓语时注意主谓一致和时态；可按规则变化，遇到不规则形式以词典为准。
collocations: sleep soundly; sleep soundly through the night
commonMistake: soundly 可表示睡得沉；常见搭配 sleep soundly，不要与 sound（声音）混淆词性。

example.english: After the rescue, the tired children slept soundly.
example.chinese: 获救后，疲惫的孩子们睡得很沉。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: After the rescue, the tired children slept soundly. In this sentence, what does “soundly” mean? A. 尖叫  B. （睡觉）酣畅地
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “soundly” 表示“（睡觉）酣畅地”，符合语境；另一项“尖叫”与句意不符。

grammar: adj. 厚的。常作定语或表语；修饰名词时通常放在名词前。
collocations: thick smoke; thick fog
commonMistake: thick 可形容厚度或浓密程度，如 a thick wall / thick smoke；thin 是反义词。

example.english: Thick smoke made it hard to see the road.
example.chinese: 浓烟使人很难看清道路。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Thick smoke made it hard to see the road. In this sentence, what does “thick” mean? A. 厚的  B. 西南的
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “thick” 表示“厚的”，符合语境；另一项“西南的”与句意不符。

grammar: n./v. 敲打；beat—beat—beaten，过去式与原形同形。
collocations: heart beats fast; beat someone at a game
commonMistake: beat 的过去式仍是 beat，过去分词是 beaten；不要误写为 beated。

example.english: Her heart began to beat faster as the wind grew stronger.
example.chinese: 风势增强时，她的心跳开始加快。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Her heart began to beat faster as the wind grew stronger. In this sentence, what does “beat” mean? A. 卫兵  B. 跳动
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “beat” 表示“跳动”，符合语境；另一项“卫兵”与句意不符。

grammar: v. 躲藏；hide—hid—hidden，注意过去式和过去分词。
collocations: hide from danger; hide something under a table
commonMistake: hide 的过去式为 hid，过去分词为 hidden。

example.english: Hide under a strong table during an earthquake.
example.chinese: 地震时要躲在结实的桌子下面。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: Hide under a strong table during an earthquake. In this sentence, what does “hide” mean? A. 躲藏  B. 尖叫
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “hide” 表示“躲藏”，符合语境；另一项“尖叫”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 龙卷风。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a powerful tornado; tornado warning
commonMistake: tornado 是可数名词；复数常写 tornadoes。

example.english: The tornado damaged several houses near the town.
example.chinese: 龙卷风损坏了城镇附近的几栋房屋。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The tornado damaged several houses near the town. In this sentence, what does “tornado” mean? A. 屋顶  B. 龙卷风
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “tornado” 表示“龙卷风”，符合语境；另一项“屋顶”与句意不符。

grammar: adj./adv. 最坏（的）。bad、badly 的最高级；注意最高级形式和语境。
collocations: the worst storm; at its worst
commonMistake: worst 是 bad/badly 的最高级；常与 the 连用作形容词最高级。

example.english: That was the worst storm the village had seen in years.
example.chinese: 那是这个村庄多年来遭遇的最严重的一场风暴。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: That was the worst storm the village had seen in years. In this sentence, what does “worst” mean? A. 最坏（的）  B. 附近的
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “worst” 表示“最坏（的）”，符合语境；另一项“附近的”与句意不符。

grammar: n. （学校的）女生。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a young schoolgirl; schoolgirl uniform
commonMistake: schoolgirl 指女学生，是合成词；不要与 schoolboy 混淆性别含义。

example.english: The schoolgirl carried water to the shelter.
example.chinese: 那个女学生把水送到了避难所。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The schoolgirl carried water to the shelter. In this sentence, what does “schoolgirl” mean? A. 泡  B. （学校的）女生
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “schoolgirl” 表示“（学校的）女生”，符合语境；另一项“泡”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 泡。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。

commonMistake: by the time 引导时间从句，搭配时态需看主句事件发生的先后。

example.english: By the time help arrived, the rain had stopped.
example.chinese: 救援到达时，雨已经停了。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: By the time help arrived, the rain had stopped. In this sentence, what does “by the time” mean? A. 保安人员  B. 到……的时候
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “by the time” 表示“到……的时候”，符合语境；另一项“保安人员”与句意不符。

grammar: adj. 通常的。常作定语或表语；修饰名词时通常放在名词前。
collocations: as usual; the usual place
commonMistake: usual 是形容词；副词“通常”是 usually，注意不能用 usual 修饰动词。

example.english: The river was higher than usual after the storm.
example.chinese: 暴风雨过后，河水比平时高。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The river was higher than usual after the storm. In this sentence, what does “usual” mean? A. 通常的  B. 突然的
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “usual” 表示“通常的”，符合语境；另一项“突然的”与句意不符。

grammar: phr. 上气不接下气。整体记忆为固定表达；句中动词按主语和时态变化。
collocations: be out of breath; get out of breath
commonMistake: 固定说 out of breath，意为“上气不接下气”；不要说 out of breathe。

example.english: After running uphill, we were out of breath.
example.chinese: 跑上坡后，我们都气喘吁吁。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: After running uphill, we were out of breath. In this sentence, what does “out of breath” mean? A. 因此  B. 上气不接下气
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “out of breath” 表示“上气不接下气”，符合语境；另一项“因此”与句意不符。

grammar: n. 暴风雨。注意结合语境判断可数性；名词可作主语、宾语或表语。
collocations: a heavy rainstorm; during a rainstorm
commonMistake: rainstorm 是一个词；形容暴雨常用 a heavy rainstorm。

example.english: The rainstorm flooded several streets overnight.
example.chinese: 暴雨一夜之间淹没了几条街道。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The rainstorm flooded several streets overnight. In this sentence, what does “rainstorm” mean? A. 暴风雨  B. 准备（工作）
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “rainstorm” 表示“暴风雨”，符合语境；另一项“准备（工作）”与句意不符。

grammar: phr. 因此。整体记忆为固定表达；句中动词按主语和时态变化。
collocations: as a result of; as a result, ...
commonMistake: as a result 表示“因此”；as a result of 后接名词或名词短语。

example.english: The road was closed; as a result, buses were delayed.
example.chinese: 道路封闭了，因此公交车晚点了。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The road was closed; as a result, buses were delayed. In this sentence, what does “as a result” mean? A. 一……就……  B. 因此
application.solution: B。解析：句中 “as a result” 表示“因此”，符合语境；另一项“一……就……”与句意不符。

grammar: adj. 不幸的。常作定语或表语；修饰名词时通常放在名词前。
collocations: an unlucky day; feel unlucky
commonMistake: unlucky 是形容词，unluckily 是副词；按修饰对象选择词形。

example.english: The unlucky camper woke up to a broken tent after the storm.
example.chinese: 这个倒霉的露营者醒来时发现帐篷被风暴刮坏了。

application.prompt: Read this sentence: The unlucky camper woke up to a broken tent after the storm. In this sentence, what does “unlucky” mean? A. 不幸的  B. 突然的
application.solution: A。解析：句中 “unlucky” 表示“不幸的”，符合语境；另一项“突然的”与句意不符。
